newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 19.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 19.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were reported open Wednesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
Dos Bocas in Tabasco state reopened at 1500 local/2100 Tuesday after being shut since Friday.
The bulletin advised ships to exercise caution when sailing in the Gulf of Tehuantepec because of winds and high waves.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.
Cold front hovering above Chihuahua and Sinaloa states. Winds from 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 miles per hour) and waves four to six feet high.
Light rains above states of Tamaulipas and northern Veracruz. Clear skies along rest of coast with winds from east from 10 to 20 knots.
Some clouds and rains, moderate winds from northeast at 20 to 30 km per hour.
